steps.name: pg-test-harness
steps.summary: Added src/test/pg.ts embedded Postgres harness with applyMigrations, grantSupabaseRoles, createUser, runAs, runAsAnon, and withRollback plus Vitest global setup and smoke tests.

steps.name: schema-migrations
steps.summary: Added initial Supabase schema migration for enums, six tables, constraints, and updated_at triggers with integration coverage.

steps.name: rls-policies
steps.summary: Added RLS enablement and authenticated owner-scoped policies with append-only event tables plus boundary tests.

steps.name: indexes
steps.summary: Added database indexes for active owner lookups, unpaid due dates, client joins, and event timelines with integration coverage.

steps.name: generated-types
steps.summary: Added Supabase CLI-backed database type generation and replaced the Database stub with introspected public schema types.

steps.name: query-helpers
steps.summary: Added typed db query helpers for soft-delete filtering and RLS-scoped ownership checks with mock builder unit tests.
